jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct this Naotocchi mature Japanese rhinoceros beetle. The user wants BOTH EYES visible but rejects a head twisted toward the viewer while body faces sideways. Therefore ROTATE THE ENTIRE BEETLE TOWARD A NEAR-FRONTAL THREE-QUARTER VIEW, not just the head. This requires redrawing its whole pose, not painting another eye onto the side profile.
Composition: body recedes directly behind head, slightly to upper LEFT, whole animal points diagonally toward lower RIGHT and viewer. The head, pronotum, and abdomen share ONE straight continuous longitudinal axis and exactly the SAME yaw angle. Front-facing three-quarter view ~20 degrees to viewer's right (not near-side-profile). BOTH EYES must be fully visible on the actual HEAD, the farther eye a little narrower due to perspective. A small friendly mouth centered below the eyes, cheek accents, head a modest natural size closely attached to front of blank thorax, no long neck and no sideways bend. The HEAD is at the front of thorax, NOT a face on the thorax or shell. Make the thorax and pair of wing covers match the head's near-frontal view, with roughly balanced left/right visible shell and leg perspective. No sideways oval body plus forward-facing mask.
Japanese rhinoceros beetle identity: warm mature chestnut brown glossy paired wing covers, separate plain pronotum behind head, ONE long fork-tipped head horn originating from the FRONT FOREHEAD between/in front of the eyes and sweeping forward/up in same direction as the WHOLE beetle, small secondary pronotal horn behind. Six short jointed insect legs, THREE ON EACH SIDE visible in natural planted stance, two short antennae from head. Cute compact nonhumanoid beetle, no human arms, no upright stance. Keep head integrated and aligned. Both eyes visible is mandatory, no one-eyed profile.
Crisp stepped low-resolution pixel art, limited color clusters for 128px game sprite, minimal shading, dark-brown outline, no blur. ONE complete full-body sprite, square, centered with generous blank borders, perfectly flat vivid magenta RGB(255,0,255) background for extraction. No checkerboard, text, shadow, ground or props. No magenta inside the beetle.
